newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Ports of Auckland plans second Westhaven upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Ports of Auckland plans second Westhaven upgrade.

text.p: Ports of Auckland Ltd plans another upgrade for its for Westhaven Marina, to be funded along similar lines to the 255-berth expansion in 1995, Chairman Sir Richard Carter said on Tuesday.

Carter told a news briefing that the previous offer of options for 30-year licences had proved extremely successful, leading to plans for the upgrade of 330 berths from piers B through to F. He said the response had so far been positive.
"If the board gives the final go ahead to the proposal, the main financial impact will start to come through in the next 12 months," Carter said.

"It should, by and large, be pretty similar to the success that we had with the recent 255-berth proposal which we've seen reflected in previous year's results, and that was basically a self-funding proposition," Carter said.
Ports of Auckland earlier announced a fall in net profit to NZ$17.4 million in the first half to December, down from $24.5 million, mostly reflecting discontinued property activities.

Carter told last year's annual meeting that the company was in for a tough trading period, and that had proved to be the case. Conditions had been tougher than any of the last four years as a listed public company, he said.
